property_summary: After any call to addToBalance(), the sum of all userBalance entries in the contract equals the sum of all values ever deposited minus the sum of all successful withdrawals; the bug breaks this because msg.value is credited to address(0) instead of the caller, leaving the caller's balance unchanged while increasing address(0)'s balance.
change_summary: Replace msg.sender with a constant address (e.g. address(0)) in the balance update, so the caller's balance is not changed but that other address's balance is.
